column3: (Suspicious comments: matches the word "from" in code comments)
(User controllable attribute: the pages are fixed files; nothing from the address is written into them)
(Non-storable content: redirects and private answers are not cached, on purpose)
(CSP wildcard: img-src https: lets search results show covers; see docs/SECURITY-AND-TESTS.md)
(Anti-CSRF tokens: changes need the X-Starboard header and a matching Origin; the flagged forms are Display panel forms that send nothing)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: would block cover pictures from other sites; see docs/SECURITY-AND-TESTS.md)
(Timestamp disclosure: answers carry times, such as when an app was last checked; not secret)
(Private IP disclosure: /api/network lists the addresses to open Starboard from, for signed-in people only; the signed-out scan finds none)
